Blocks.Name: Revenue growth
Blocks.OutputTitleTemplate: Revenue growth, calculated by an Agent block with Python in its sandbox

Properties.PromptTemplate:
The annual report in your workspace states the company's revenue for 2024 and for 2025, in millions.

1. Find both revenue figures in the report.
2. Run a Python command in your sandbox that calculates the growth from 2024 to 2025 as a percentage, rounded to one decimal place.
3. Answer with exactly one line: Revenue growth: <the percentage>%

WorkerSkills.Name: growth-from-two-figures
WorkerSkills.Description: Use when a task asks for the growth between two figures of a report.
WorkerSkills.Content: Find both figures in the document and note the page of each. Calculate the growth with Python as (later - earlier) / earlier * 100, and round it to one decimal place. Never calculate it in your head.
